procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.5. AUS 2389 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: During races 1 and 2, AUS 2389's sail number was not clearly legible to the race committee.
decision: AUS 2389 is given a warning in accordance with RRS G4. AUS 2389 to pursue remedial action as directed by the Technical Committee, implementing remedial action before starting any further races.
